"""

Supports multiple environments (dev, staging, production)

### **3. database/models.py**

```python
"""
Database models for Bug Bounty Finder
Defines the structure for programs, vulnerabilities, and user interactions
"""

from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy
from datetime import datetime
from enum import Enum
import uuid

db = SQLAlchemy()


class SeverityLevel(Enum):
    """Vulnerability severity levels"""
    CRITICAL = "critical"
    HIGH = "high"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    LOW = "low"
    INFO = "info"


class ProgramStatus(Enum):
    """Program status enum"""
    ACTIVE = "active"
    PAUSED = "paused"
    CLOSED = "closed"
    PRIVATE = "private"


class BugBountyProgram(db.Model):
    """
    Main model representing a bug bounty program
    
    Attributes:
        id: Unique identifier
        name: Program name
        platform: Source platform (HackerOne, Bugcrowd, etc.)
        url: Program URL
        description: Program description
        status: Current status
        min_bounty: Minimum bounty amount
        max_bounty: Maximum bounty amount
        currency: Currency of bounty
        vulnerabilities_sought: Types of vulnerabilities being hunted
        response_time: Average response time in hours
        reputation: Platform reputation score
        logo_url: Program logo URL
        tags: Categories/tags
        created_at: When program was added
        updated_at: Last update time
    """
    
    __tablename__ = 'bug_bounty_programs'
    
    id = db.Column(db.String(36), primary_key=True, default=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    
    # Basic Information
    name = db.Column(db.String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    platform = db.Column(db.String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    url = db.Column(db.String(500), nullable=False, unique=True)
    description = db.Column(db.Text)
    logo_url = db.Column(db.String(500))
    
    # Financial Information
    min_bounty = db.Column(db.Integer, default=0)
    max_bounty = db.Column(db.Integer, default=0)
    currency = db.Column(db.String(10), default='USD')
    
    # Status & Metadata
    status = db.Column(
        db.Enum(ProgramStatus),
        nullable=False,
        default=ProgramStatus.ACTIVE,
        index=True
    )
    
    # Program Details
    vulnerabilities_sought = db.Column(db.JSON)  # List of vulnerability types
    response_time = db.Column(db.Float)  # Average response time in hours
    reputation_score = db.Column(db.Float, default=0.0)  # 0-100 scale
    
    # Relationships
    tags = db.Column(db.JSON, default=list)  # Categories: web, mobile, api, etc.
    
    # Tracking
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)
    last_scraped = db.Column(db.DateTime)
    
    # Relationships
    submissions = db.relationship('UserSubmission', backref='program', lazy=True, cascade='all, delete-orphan')
    statistics = db.relationship('ProgramStatistic', backref='program', lazy=True, uselist=False, cascade='all, delete-orphan')
    
    def __repr__(self):
        return f'<BugBountyProgram {self.name}>'
    
    def to_dict(self):
        """Convert model to dictionary"""
        return {
            'id': self.id,
            'name': self.name,
            'platform': self.platform,
            'url': self.url,
            'description': self.description,
            'logo_url': self.logo_url,
            'min_bounty': self.min_bounty,
            'max_bounty': self.max_bounty,
            'currency': self.currency,
            'status': self.status.value,
            'vulnerabilities_sought': self.vulnerabilities_sought,
            'response_time': self.response_time,
            'reputation_score': self.reputation_score,
            'tags': self.tags,
            'created_at': self.created_at.isoformat(),
            'updated_at': self.updated_at.isoformat(),
        }


class ProgramStatistic(db.Model):
    """
    Statistics for bug bounty programs
    Tracks popularity, participation metrics, etc.
    """
    
    __tablename__ = 'program_statistics'
    
    id = db.Column(db.String(36), primary_key=True, default=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    program_id = db.Column(db.String(36), db.ForeignKey('bug_bounty_programs.id'), nullable=False)
    
    # Engagement metrics
    total_views = db.Column(db.Integer, default=0)
    total_submissions = db.Column(db.Integer, default=0)
    average_payout = db.Column(db.Float, default=0.0)
    median_payout = db.Column(db.Float, default=0.0)
    
    # Acceptance rate
    acceptance_rate = db.Column(db.Float, default=0.0)  # Percentage
    
    # Timing metrics
    average_resolution_time = db.Column(db.Float, default=0.0)  # Days
    
    # Updated at
    updated_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)
    
    def __repr__(self):
        return f'<ProgramStatistic {self.program_id}>'


class UserSubmission(db.Model):
    """
    Track user interest/submissions to programs
    For future: user bookmarks, participation history
    """
    
    __tablename__ = 'user_submissions'
    
    id = db.Column(db.String(36), primary_key=True, default=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    program_id = db.Column(db.String(36), db.ForeignKey('bug_bounty_programs.id'), nullable=False)
    
    # User info (can be expanded with user authentication)
    user_identifier = db.Column(db.String(255))  # Anonymous ID or username
    
    # Submission details
    vulnerability_type = db.Column(db.String(255))
    bounty_received = db.Column(db.Integer)
    severity = db.Column(db.Enum(SeverityLevel))
    
    # Timestamps
    submitted_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    resolved_at = db.Column(db.DateTime)
    
    def __repr__(self):
        return f'<UserSubmission {self.id}>'


class ScraperLog(db.Model):
    """
    Logs for scraper activities
    For debugging and monitoring
    """
    
    __tablename__ = 'scraper_logs'
    
    id = db.Column(db.String(36), primary_key=True, default=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    scraper_name = db.Column(db.String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    status = db.Column(db.String(50))  # success, failure, partial
    programs_found = db.Column(db.Integer, default=0)
    programs_updated = db.Column(db.Integer, default=0)
    error_message = db.Column(db.Text)
    
    started_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    completed_at = db.Column(db.DateTime)
    
    def __repr__(self):
        return f'<ScraperLog {self.scraper_name} - {self.status}>'
```

### **4. scrapers/base_scraper.py**

```python
"""
Base scraper class with common functionality
All specific scrapers inherit from this class
"""

import requests
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import List, Dict, Any
from datetime import datetime
import logging
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry
from config import Config

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class BaseScraper(ABC):
    """
    Abstract base class for all scrapers
    Provides common methods for HTTP requests, error handling, etc.
    
    TODO Features:
    - Proxy rotation support
    - Rate limiting
    - Captcha detection
    """
    
    def __init__(self, name: str):
        """
        Initialize scraper
        
        Args:
            name: Scraper identifier
        """
        self.name = name
        self.session = self._create_session()
        self.timeout = Config.REQUEST_TIMEOUT
        self.retry_attempts = Config.RETRY_ATTEMPTS
        self.retry_delay = Config.RETRY_DELAY
    
    def _create_session(self) -> requests.Session:
        """
        Create a requests session with retry strategy
        Implements exponential backoff
        """
        session = requests.Session()
        
        retry_strategy = Retry(
            total=self.retry_attempts,
            backoff_factor=self.retry_delay,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["HEAD", "GET", "OPTIONS"]
        )
        
        adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry_strategy)
        session.mount("http://", adapter)
        session.mount("https://", adapter)
        
        session.headers.update({
            'User-Agent': Config.USER_AGENT
        })
        
        return session
    
    def _get(self, url: str, **kwargs) -> requests.Response:
        """
        Make GET request with error handling
        
        Args:
            url: URL to request
            **kwargs: Additional arguments for requests.get()
            
        Returns:
            Response object
            
        Raises:
            requests.RequestException: If request fails
        """
        try:
            kwargs.setdefault('timeout', self.timeout)
            response = self.session.get(url, **kwargs)
            response.raise_for_status()
            return response
        except requests.RequestException as e:
            logger.error(f"Request failed for {url}: {str(e)}")
            raise
    
    def _post(self, url: str, **kwargs) -> requests.Response:
        """Make POST request with error handling"""
        try:
            kwargs.setdefault('timeout', self.timeout)
            response = self.session.post(url, **kwargs)
            response.raise_for_status()
            return response
        except requests.RequestException as e:
            logger.error(f"POST request failed for {url}: {str(e)}")
            raise
    
    @abstractmethod
    def scrape(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        Main scraping method
        Must be implemented by subclasses
        
        Returns:
            List of program dictionaries with structure:
            {
                'name': str,
                'url': str,
                'description': str,
                'min_bounty': int,
                'max_bounty': int,
                'currency': str,
                'vulnerabilities_sought': list,
                'response_time': float,
                'reputation_score': float,
                'tags': list,
                'status': str,
                'logo_url': str
            }
        """
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def get_platform_name(self) -> str:
        """Return the platform name"""
        pass
    
    def validate_program_data(self, program: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        """
        Validate scraped program data
        
        Args:
            program: Program dictionary
            
        Returns:
            True if valid, False otherwise
        """
        required_fields = ['name', 'url', 'platform']
        
        for field in required_fields:
            if field not in program or not program[field]:
                logger.warning(f"Missing required field '{field}' in program: {program.get('name', 'Unknown')}")
                return False
        
        return True
    
    def normalize_program_data(self, program: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Normalize program data to standard format
        
        Args:
            program: Raw program data
            
        Returns:
            Normalized program data
        """
        return {
            'name': program.get('name', '').strip(),
            'url': program.get('url', '').strip(),
            'platform': self.get_platform_name(),
            'description': program.get('description', '').strip(),
            'min_bounty': program.get('min_bounty', 0),
            'max_bounty': program.get('max_bounty', 0),
            'currency': program.get('currency', 'USD').upper(),
            'vulnerabilities_sought': program.get('vulnerabilities_sought', []),
            'response_time': program.get('response_time', None),
            'reputation_score': program.get('reputation_score', 0.0),
            'tags': program.get('tags', []),
            'status': program.get('status', 'active'),
            'logo_url': program.

"""
Base scraper class with common functionality
All specific scrapers inherit from this class
"""

import requests
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import List, Dict, Any
from datetime import datetime
import logging
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry
from config import Config

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class BaseScraper(ABC):
    """
    Abstract base class for all scrapers
    Provides common methods for HTTP requests, error handling, etc.
    
    TODO Features:
    - Proxy rotation support
    - Rate limiting
    - Captcha detection
    """
    
    def __init__(self, name: str):
        """
        Initialize scraper
        
        Args:
            name: Scraper identifier
        """
        self.name = name
        self.session = self._create_session()
        self.timeout = Config.REQUEST_TIMEOUT
        self.retry_attempts = Config.RETRY_ATTEMPTS
        self.retry_delay = Config.RETRY_DELAY
    
    def _create_session(self) -> requests.Session:
        """
        Create a requests session with retry strategy
        Implements exponential backoff
        """
        session = requests.Session()
        
        retry_strategy = Retry(
            total=self.retry_attempts,
            backoff_factor=self.retry_delay,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["HEAD", "GET", "OPTIONS"]
        )
        
        adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry_strategy)
        session.mount("http://", adapter)
        session.mount("https://", adapter)
        
        session.headers.update({
            'User-Agent': Config.USER_AGENT
        })
        
        return session
    
    def _get(self, url: str, **kwargs) -> requests.Response:
        """
        Make GET request with error handling
        
        Args:
            url: URL to request
            **kwargs: Additional arguments for requests.get()
            
        Returns:
            Response object
            
        Raises:
            requests.RequestException: If request fails
        """
        try:
            kwargs.setdefault('timeout', self.timeout)
            response = self.session.get(url, **kwargs)
            response.raise_for_status()
            return response
        except requests.RequestException as e:
            logger.error(f"Request failed for {url}: {str(e)}")
            raise
    
    def _post(self, url: str, **kwargs) -> requests.Response:
        """Make POST request with error handling"""
        try:
            kwargs.setdefault('timeout', self.timeout)
            response = self.session.post(url, **kwargs)
            response.raise_for_status()
            return response
        except requests.RequestException as e:
            logger.error(f"POST request failed for {url}: {str(e)}")
            raise
    
    @abstractmethod
    def scrape(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        Main scraping method
        Must be implemented by subclasses
        
        Returns:
            List of program dictionaries with structure:
            {
                'name': str,
                'url': str,
                'description': str,
                'min_bounty': int,
                'max_bounty': int,
                'currency': str,
                'vulnerabilities_sought': list,
                'response_time': float,
                'reputation_score': float,
                'tags': list,
                'status': str,
                'logo_url': str
            }
        """
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def get_platform_name(self) -> str:
        """Return the platform name"""
        pass
    
    def validate_program_data(self, program: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        """
        Validate scraped program data
        
        Args:
            program: Program dictionary
            
        Returns:
            True if valid, False otherwise
        """
        required_fields = ['name', 'url', 'platform']
        
        for field in required_fields:
            if field not in program or not program[field]:
                logger.warning(f"Missing required field '{field}' in program: {program.get('name', 'Unknown')}")
                return False
        
        return True
    
    def normalize_program_data(self, program: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Normalize program data to standard format
        
        Args:
            program: Raw program data
            
        Returns:
            Normalized program data
        """
        return {
            'name': program.get('name', '').strip(),
            'url': program.get('url', '').strip(),
            'platform': self.get_platform_name(),
            'description': program.get('description', '').strip(),
            'min_bounty': program.get('min_bounty', 0),
            'max_bounty': program.get('max_bounty', 0),
            'currency': program.get('currency', 'USD').upper(),
            'vulnerabilities_sought': program.get('vulnerabilities_sought', []),
            'response_time': program.get('response_time', None),
            'reputation_score': program.get('reputation_score', 0.0),
            'tags': program.get('tags', []),
            'status': program.get('status', 'active'),
            'logo_url': program.
